## HarvardX Professional Certificate in Tiny Machine Learning

The complete courseware from the [HarvardX TinyML Professional Certificate on edX](https://www.edx.org/professional-certificate/harvardx-tiny-machine-learning): four courses, in five chapters, that run from ML fundamentals through embedded deployment and MLOps. The materials include slide decks, readings, Colab notebooks, and supplementary material. Harvard SEAS and the Google TensorFlow team developed the original courseware.

